text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, we've finally made it. To the 
foot of the "pinnacle."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"To tell the truth, I thought it would 
take much, much longer... About a year 
more, perhaps."
choice_data_list: Yeah... It's the fruit of your hard work.
Yeah... It's the fruit of your hard work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute's wish: "I want to show hope 
as soon as possible to the people trying 
to get back on their feet."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her strong feelings combined with rigorous 
training miraculously got her ready in 
time for the end of the Classic year.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just catching up like this is plenty 
enough, I think~. But...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"If I run a pathetic race, they'll just be 
disappointed and think I only showed up 
for the sake of it."

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well Trainer-san, shall we get going? With 
how I am right now, I'm sure I can do 
reasonably well...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Puffing and swaying her shoulders, she 
heads toward the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And right there—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!!!!!! Thank you so much for 
coming to watch the Tokyo Daishoten!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Let's make this the best day 
everrrrr!!!!!!! Enjoy the races and the 
concerts to your heart's content☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was truly the Smart Falcon show... An 
overwhelming, extraordinary brilliance...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon doesn't view Ohi today as 
just an ordinary racetrack. To entertain 
everyone, she is putting everything on the 
line...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Is this...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My legs feel like they've turned to 
jelly... Falco-san really is amazing, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Faced with the sheer difference in 
caliber. Just how close can she truly get?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san, Acute-san! I'm looking forward 
to working with you today♪

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Falco-san. Pleased to be workin' with 
ya too~

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Aha, I was waiting for you! I just knew 
you'd come to this Tokyo Daishoten☆

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Haeee... Me?! Are you sure they're coming 
for me?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I've been curious about her for a 
while now. About Acute-san.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe Acute-san is the true comrade 
who'll fire up the dirt scene from here on 
out! ☆"

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Comrades... Neither a junior nor a 
rival...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the track, we're "rivals." But when it 
comes to making the show a success, we're 
"comrades."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's not just her running that makes Smart 
Falcon amazing. It's precisely because she 
has this perspective as an Umadol...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Acute-san, are you warmed up? Did you get 
enough water? Make sure your shoelaces 
don't come undone.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Well then—let's go, to our stage!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeeek!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As things stand, we're being led in every 
way. She'll probably take a considerable 
lead in the race too. Even so—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute pursues desperately. That 
distant, divine back.
